sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United, sitting top with 37 points from 17 games, travel to Stafford Town on Saturday 28 November at 15:00. Sandbach arrive in excellent form, having won their last two league matches and showing resilience with two wins in their last five outings. Stafford Town (9 wins, 32 points, 4th place) will provide a stern test, though they've been inconsistent recently with one win in their last three league games.
divisionWide: Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, who sit just three points behind leaders Sandbach with 34 points, host Dawley Town on Saturday 28 November. Casuals are in outstanding form with six consecutive league wins and will be expected to extend that run. Elsewhere on Saturday, Barnton face Eccleshall in a mid-table encounter with both sides in good form, while Allscott Heath host Crewe—Allscott are on a three-game winning streak while Crewe (18 points) continue to struggle. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to AFC Bridgnorth, with the visitors looking to halt a poor run while Bridgnorth (3rd, 33 points) have won their last league outing. Foley Meir host New Mills in a clash between struggling sides, Telford Town (10th, 10 points) visit Widnes Town (20th, 8 points) in a bottom-half fixture, and Wednesfield Community host Shawbury United as both seek consistency. Tuesday 1 December sees New Mills visit Wolverhampton Casuals (likely to favour the in-form hosts), Wednesfield Community host Barnton, and Widnes Town entertain Allscott Heath. The following Saturday 5 December features a busy round: AFC Bridgnorth host Dawley Town, Alsager Town welcome struggling Market Drayton Town (17 points), Bilston Town entertain Allscott Heath, Foley Meir visit Telford Town, Shawbury United face Eccleshall, Stafford Town host Brereton Social, Wednesfield Community visit New Mills, Widnes Town entertain Crewe, and Wolverhampton Casuals welcome Barnton in a potentially crucial fixture for the title race.
